definitions.explanation: A casual first-person plural pronoun typically used by males.

examples.japanese: {僕|ぼく}ら⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧だ。
{僕|ぼく}ら⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: In our day, there were no smartphones.

examples.japanese: {僕|ぼく}ら⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせれば→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧、⟦きっと→きっと：00860_kitto⟧⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}えられる→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: If we join forces, we can surely change something.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{僕|ぼく}→僕：01729_boku⟧ (I, masculine informal) + ら (plural suffix). A casual first-person plural pronoun most commonly used by boys, young men, and adult men in informal contexts. Very common in song lyrics, manga, anime, and casual speech among friends.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {僕|ぼく}ら⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧: our generation
- {僕|ぼく}ら⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧: our era
- {僕|ぼく}ら⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧: our companions

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{私|わたし}たち→私たち：28351_watashitachi⟧: we — gender-neutral and more polite; the standard first-person plural
- ⟦{俺|おれ}→俺：02185_ore⟧ら: we — rougher and more masculine than {僕|ぼく}ら
- ⟦{我々|われわれ}→我々：03795_wareware⟧: we — formal and often used in speeches, official contexts
- {僕|ぼく}たち: we — slightly more polite/formal than {僕|ぼく}ら but still masculine

REGISTER:
{僕|ぼく}ら is distinctly informal. It would not be used in business settings or formal writing. The ら suffix is more casual than たち, making {僕|ぼく}ら feel more intimate than {僕|ぼく}たち.
